column2: Well then, do your best to survive, powerless white $$羽$$s.
Well then, do your best to survive, powerless white $$羽$$s.
Well then, do your best to survive, powerless white $$羽$$s.
S-so strong... What incredible strength!!
But why does he not kill us all at once?!
“Like a cat, I enjoy playing with a mouse a little before I eat it...”
Of course... that was something $$メフィスト$$ used to say...
Even I pity the sorrowful days you endure...
Almost enough to make me stop most of the pleasures I take in tormenting the wretched...
For one like me, who lives through eternity,
strength itself has long since lost all value...
I have had time enough to hone my skills...
more than enough to grow tired of it...
But you, whose time is limited...
I wonder: do you truly use that time well?!
You are...
descendants of those they call $$サル$$s...?!
Tch... I too was once...
one of the wingless people cursed and destroyed by $$大悪神ゴッド$$...
one of that accursed race without $$羽$$...
But in exchange for eternal life, I made a pact with $$メフィスト$$...
and lost even the ability to die by my own hand...
Thanks to you, I can finally sleep...
To you...
I should offer some thanks...
Take this Sword of $$友愛$$ with you...
This sword...
is what $$メフィスト$$ gave me as proof of the pact I made with him...
